calculate_mel_frames_dasheng: calculate the number of Mel-spectrogram frames from audio samples using configurable FFT and subsampling parameters
build_audio_encoder_transformer: build a DashengAudioTransformer that converts audio waveforms to encoded embeddings via frontend, patch embedding, and transformer blocks
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on MiDashengLMModel with input IDs, positions, and a ForwardBatch containing multimodal audio inputs
load_model_weights: load model weights for MiDashengLMModel mapping audio encoder, audio projector, and decoder parameters from a weight iterable
build_audio_projector: build an AudioProjectorSubsample that downsamples audio embeddings by grouping frames and projecting to language model dimension
